user.title: Set up Load Optimizer
user.description: Create an optimizer for a flexible electrical load. Use learned_appliance to migrate the existing add-on runtime, or ev_charging for EV planning.

ev.title: Set up EV charging
ev.description: This mode recommends charging windows only. Use the charge-now binary sensor in a Home Assistant automation if you want to control a charger switch.

learned_appliance.title: Migrate learned appliances
learned_appliance.description: Paste the same add-on options first. After setup, call load_optimizer.import_legacy_state with the contents of /data/load_optimizer.json from the old add-on.

init.title: Load Optimizer settings
init.description: Choose the part of Load Optimizer you want to change. Saving one section preserves every other setting.

menu_option_descriptions.appliances_tariff: Appliance definitions, refresh timing, tariff entities and calendar windows.
menu_option_descriptions.optimisation: Search horizon, forecast resolution and schedule preference weighting.
menu_option_descriptions.publishing: Choose whether detailed profiles, forecasts and diagnostics are exposed.
menu_option_descriptions.price_cap: Regional Ofgem default-tariff benchmark shown alongside dynamic prices.
menu_option_descriptions.dishwasher_control: Home Connect entities used only for automatic dishwasher starting and verification.

appliances_tariff.title: Appliances and tariff
appliances_tariff.description: These are the integration's main data sources. Existing values are retained unless you change and save them here.

optimisation.title: Cost optimisation
optimisation.description: Control how far ahead Load Optimizer searches and how precisely it evaluates possible start times.

publishing.title: Published data
publishing.description: Detailed attributes are useful for dashboards and troubleshooting but can increase state size.

price_cap.title: Price-cap benchmark
price_cap.description: Choose the Ofgem electricity region and payment method used for the daily default-tariff benchmark. This is a comparison line, not a cap on dynamic tariff prices.

dishwasher_control.title: Dishwasher control (optional)
dishwasher_control.description: Only configure these Home Connect references when Load Optimizer should start and verify a dishwasher automatically. They are not required for learning, tariff analysis, washing machines, robot vacuums or EVs.

abort.not_supported: This optimizer type has no editable orchestration options.
